external_primary_refresh.github_actions_billing: GitHub documentation states Actions usage is free for self-hosted runners; private-repository GitHub-hosted jobs consume included minutes and can incur billing.
external_primary_refresh.github_self_hosted_security: GitHub documentation warns that persistent self-hosted runners require controlled trust boundaries; workflow access and untrusted pull-request execution must be constrained.
external_primary_refresh.decision_consequence: Do not globally move arbitrary PR execution to the persistent runner. Use a trusted controller that fetches an immutable reviewed target SHA into an isolated directory with read-only repository permission.
